connector.name: Bargo Congress Trades
connector.registryDescription: Query normalized U.S. Congress STOCK Act trades with member, ticker, and performance data.
connector.summary: Hosted at bargo.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bargo-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
